blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — Two more Nigerian men were arrested in Angeles City on Sunday after P105,000 worth of illegal drugs were allegedly found in their possession. Their arrest was made a day after a 46-year-old Nigerian man was arrested in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Balibago, Angeles City, that yielded some P5.96 million worth of suspected ecstasy pills.
